Certificate needed

Hi Daniel,

We don't yet have a breeder certificate on file for your AQUA AI account.

You can still list your stock and let customers collect in person. A valid certificate also lets you offer delivery.

Selling animals as pets as a business usually needs a licence. To find out how to get one, see our guide at aquaai.uk/faqs.

Upload your certificate in the Aqua Providers app, under your account settings. We'll review it and switch delivery on for you once it's approved.

If you need any help, just reply to this email or contact support@aquaai.uk.

If you only sell for collection in person, there's nothing you need to do.

Thank you,
The AQUA AI team
